strapiBlog.title: All About the Dubai Water Canal - A Waterfront Marvel
strapiBlog.short_description: Dubai Water Canal is a 3.2km-long waterway stretching from Dubai Creek in Old Dubai, through Business Bay, and back to the Arabian Gulf.

data.text:
Dubai Water Canal is a 3.2km-long waterway stretching from Dubai Creek in Old Dubai, through Business Bay, and back to the Arabian Gulf. This man-made channel, opened in 2016, winds through the heart of the city, transforming Downtown Dubai into a vibrant waterfront destination. Let’s find out more about this breathtaking development, from nearby attractions and restaurants to things to do.

Things to Do at the Dubai Water Canal

The Dubai Water Canal offers a variety of activities for visitors, from boat rides to jogging and cycling. Here is a list of activities you can try out:

  • Stroll Along the Promenade: Enjoy a leisurely walk along the canal's beautifully landscaped promenade.
  • Take a Boat Ride: Experience the canal from the water with a boat ride or a traditional abra tour.
  • Visit the Waterfall: See the stunning Dubai Water Canal Waterfall, especially spectacular at night with its vibrant lights.
  • Explore the Bridges: Cross the iconic pedestrian bridges, including the Tolerance Bridge, for panoramic views of the canal and the city skyline.
  • Cycling Path: Rent a bike and ride along the dedicated cycling path parallel to the canal.
  • Dine at Waterfront Restaurants: Enjoy a meal at one of the many restaurants and cafes with outdoor seating offering views of the canal.
  • Watch a Light Show: Catch the nightly light shows at various points along the canal, particularly at the waterfall and bridges.
  • Jogging Path: Take advantage of the Dubai Water Canal jogging tracks for a scenic run along the waterfront.
  • Photography: Capture stunning photos of the canal, especially during sunset and at night.

How to Get There

If you're planning to visit the Dubai Water Canal using public transportation, you have several convenient options. You can start by taking a Dubai Water Canal taxi from anywhere in the city. Additionally, multiple bus lines pass by the canal, including routes 8, 81, 88, X28, F55A, 12, 15, F20, 93, and 98E. For the closest stop to the canal, get off at the Wasl Road, Box Park 2 – 1 Bus Stop. Moreover, the metro line M1 also provides direct access to the Dubai Water Canal.

Another transportation option available is the ferry. The Dubai Water Canal Ferry Station 1 is one of six ferry terminals spread across Dubai. This ferry service operates seven days a week and offers trips to Al Ghubaiba, Bluewaters Island, and Dubai Marina.

Dubai Water Canal Luxury Properties

Dubai Water Canal presents a range of off-plan projects that offer unparalleled luxury and exclusivity. Here are some of the upcoming properties along the canal. 

The Rings

The Rings by PMR Property features 5 to 6-bedroom duplexes or 6 to 7-bedroom triplexes. As you enter, you're greeted by a grand double-height lobby surrounded by peaceful reflective pools. Enjoy the convenience of personalized underground parking pods featuring a private car showroom and lifts that connect directly to the residences.

Cavalli Couture

You can choose among the 3-- to 5-bedroom apartments and 6-bedroom penthouses overlooking the Dubai Water Canal. The multi-story building also has a podium level that features various amenities, like a swimmable lagoon, spa, and gym. Moreover, Cavalli Couture will have private sky gardens and infinity pools on the rooftop. 

Eden House The Canal

Eden House by Hh Development offers various residential options, including studios, four-bedroom suites, garden duplex units, and three penthouses. Just steps from the shoreline, residents can enjoy an oceanfront lifestyle while being close to the vibrant cultural hubs of City Walk and Downtown Dubai.

Missoni - Urban Oasis

These apartments, ranging from studios to 4-bedroom options, offer stunning views of the Dubai Canal and the city's skyline. Beautifully designed by Missoni, the building features private elevators for the penthouses. With 38 floors of the finest Miami lifestyle, Missoni Urban Oasis is where you can experience luxurious, high-end living.

One Canal

One Canal offers a selection of 3 to 4-bedroom penthouses and 4- to 5-bedroom sky villas. The project by Ahs Properties provides residents with stunning canal and lake views. Residents can enjoy various distinctive amenities, like a world-class golf course membership, a personal swimming pool, and elevators leading directly to the living room.

Casa Canal Interiors by Fendi Casa

This exceptional development features an exclusive selection of 3 to 6-bedroom Sky Villas, Penthouses, Sky Mansions, and Palaces. Designed by Killa Architects and adorned with Fendi Casa interiors, Casa Canal offers five-star concierge services for unparalleled comfort and convenience. Indulge in the prestigious Rolls-Royce service, complete with a dedicated chauffeur.

Nearby Dubai Water Canal Restaurants and Other Attractions

One of the closest attractions to the Dubai Water Canal is La Perle, a mesmerizing show that blends acrobatics and theatrics in a spectacular performance. With water-themed feats and awe-inspiring dives, La Perle promises to leave you dazzled. For more outdoor excursions, Safa Park is the ideal destination. This expansive green space offers a running track, playgrounds for kids, and ample spots for relaxation, making it a perfect retreat for nature lovers.

For dining and accommodation, Al Habtoor City is a must-visit. This area boasts three five-star hotels: Habtoor Palace, LXR Hotels & Resorts; V Hotel, Curio Collection by Hilton; and Hilton Dubai Al Habtoor City. The dining options here are plentiful and diverse, ranging from American favorites at World Cut Steakhouse to Parisian pastries at BQ – French Kitchen. 

On the other side of the canal, JW Marriott Marquis Dubai offers another excellent option for both lodging and dining. Guests can enjoy exquisite meals at Prime68, the hotel's signature steakhouse, or explore the flavors of Chinese cuisine at Tan Cha. Both Al Habtoor City and JW Marriott Marquis Dubai provide luxurious stays and a wide variety of dining choices, ensuring a delightful experience for every visitor.
